name: Turkmenistan
famous_for: Darvaza Gas Crater ('Door to Hell' fiery burning pit), white marble capital city of Ashgabat, and legendary Akhal-Teke horses.
tourists: Approx. 15,000 visitors (regulated transit); famous for Darvaza burning gas crater, ancient Merv Silk Road metropolis, and Nisa ruins.
must_know: Ashgabat holds the official Guinness World Record for having the highest concentration of white marble-clad buildings in the world.
fun_fact: The Darvaza Gas Crater has been burning continuously in the heart of the Karakum Desert since geologists lit it in 1971.
